messages.text:
The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed the beeping by removing the match and win tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Card matching and visual and accessible feedback remain in place.

All 138 unit tests passed. The browser suite passed 75 checks, including a silent complete game; one score-persistence test timed out at 30 seconds, then passed when rerun with a temporary longer timeout. The original test timeout was restored.
